package fixture

import (
	"io"
	"text/template"
)

// render executes into a fake writer; no subprocess is started and nothing is
// read from disk. The template text carries an OS path unquoted.
func render(w io.Writer) {
	t := template.Must(template.New("t").Parse(`key={{.Key}} path=` + `C:\Users\RUNN\keys\key`))
	_ = t.Execute(w, nil)
}
